column1: # Partition table — ESP32-S3 N16R8 (16 MB flash).
# The old table mapped only 3.56 MB of the 16 MB chip: it was written for the
# 4 MB classic-ESP32 PoC and never grew when we migrated. 12.44 MB sat unused.
#   factory    3M   app image (1.14M used today — headroom for LVGL
#   (free)  4.94M   unallocated from 0xB10000 — reserved for a future OTA app pair
# Why "model" is a raw partition and not a file in LittleFS:
# flash-resident model weights only work if they can be memory-mapped

column2: so the MMU can fetch rows on demand without ever

column1: # copying them into RAM. mmap works on a raw partition; it does NOT work on a
